data.title: Unit 6: Matter and materials
Atoms and molecules
data.rubric: Roll the mouse over each image to refresh your memory about solids, liquids, and gases.
data.text: Matter is anything that takes up space.
data.solid: A solid has a definite size and shape that doesn't change unless someone or something applies force.
data.liquid: A liquid flows and takes the shape of the container.
data.gas: A gas doesn't have a colour or shape but may have a smell.
